steps.name: footage-capture
steps.summary: scripts/capture-footage.ts (npm run capture:footage, FOOTAGE_URL for the deployed app) records 6 clips of the real app into videos/footage/<date>/ (git-ignored): demo-hero, kiosk-touch, kiosk-mirror, phone, demo-airport, demo-pizza as .webm at CSS size plus PNGs at each key moment and manifest.json (steps in ms, model ids); waits on the session's SSE stream; typed orders hit real Gemini via /api/chat; 6/6 ok on 10-13. docs/plan/FOOTAGE.md for the editor. Logged I-143 (touch clip is the 41-tap edit path, deck cites 24) and I-144 (stale 'Your turn' line after payment). Real-phone voice footage still needs a person.

steps.name: deck-assets
steps.summary: scripts/deck-shots.ts (npm run shots:deck, own dev server, memory store, /demo snapshots hit real Gemini) writes 12 real captures to docs/assets/deck/ (phone P3/P4/P6 at 2x, kiosk K1/K3/K6 scaled to 1080 high, /demo for malo, airport_rail, doughhouse at 1920x1080 2x, guide + 'What the AI did' close-up, architecture.png 2400 px + .svg; all < 600 KB). Cost: official prices in evidence/cost-per-order.json, USD per hero order from scripts/cost.ts (text $0.0648, voice $0.0886, upper bound $0.1085; cost.test.ts), TESTING ledger updated; measure-cost.ts now keeps stored prices on re-run. SUBMISSION.md 'Solution description (draft)' 998/1,024 chars (scripts/submission.test.ts) + 2-sentence elevator. docs/plan/DECK_FACTS.md: facts per deck slot with source and measured/design/unverified. I-072 reopened: the airport snapshot's AI reply offers window/aisle seats not in the data (2/2 captures), marked 'do not use' in DECK_FACTS.
